poll.q: Binance se $6.3B ki history ki sab se bari chori — crypto exchanges par aap ka bharosa ab kaisa hai?
options: 😨 Bharosa uth gaya — funds nikaal lo
😐 Binance ne cover kar diya, theek hai
🔒 Sirf apni wallet mein rakho, exchange par nahi
💪 Hack se farq nahi — crypto future hai

https://www.coindesk.com/business/2026/1.what: Binance se $6.3 billion — history ki sab se bari crypto chori — sirf 20 minute mein, multiple chains se.
https://www.coindesk.com/business/2026/1.why: Ek DevOps engineer ka compromised laptop kaafi tha. Centralized exchange ka yehi masla hai: ek weak link, arabon ka nuqsan.
https://www.coindesk.com/business/2026/1.next: Withdrawals 45-48 ghante mein reopen hone ka wada hai; $3B frozen hai, baaqi recovery lambi kahani hogi.
https://www.coindesk.com/business/2026/1.take: Meri take: Binance ne nuqsan cover kar diya, ye bari baat hai — lekin 'your money is safe' tabhi sach hai jab withdrawal wapas khul jaye. Crypto mein exchange par bharosa hi sab se bara risk hai, ye hack phir sabit kar gaya.

https://www.malaymail.com/news/money/202.what: Intel 30% crash, Amazon 5.5% gira, Nvidia aur AMD bhi neeche — Nasdaq 2.7% down. AI spending par market ka sabar jawab de gaya.
https://www.malaymail.com/news/money/202.why: Companies arabon kharch kar rahi hain AI data centers par, lekin investors ab pooch rahe hain: paisa kab wapas aayega? Growth ki kahani khatam, hisab shuru.
https://www.malaymail.com/news/money/202.next: Tuesday ke US midterms tak focus non-tech sectors aur safe havens par rahega; agle earnings hi batayenge ke ye correction hai ya bubble burst.
https://www.malaymail.com/news/money/202.take: Meri take: Ye AI ka khatma nahi, AI hype ka hangover hai. Jo company asal revenue dikhayegi woh bachegi, baaqi 'AI' likh kar valuation nahi barha sakengi. Healthy correction hai, darne ki nahi, samajhne ki baat hai.

https://emergent.sh/news/big-ai-labs-bac.what: Chaaron bari AI labs ne pehli baar ek hi robots.txt token '__usage_ai-training' maan liya — ek line se training se opt-out.
https://emergent.sh/news/big-ai-labs-bac.why: Publishers saalon se shikayat kar rahe the ke har lab ka alag opt-out rule hai. Ab ek signal kaafi hai — lekin ye sirf draft hai, koi enforcement nahi.
https://emergent.sh/news/big-ai-labs-bac.next: Microsoft Feb 2027, Google 2027 mein implement karega; draft May 2027 mein expire ho jayega agar update na hua.
https://emergent.sh/news/big-ai-labs-bac.take: Meri take: Achi shuruaat, adhoora hal. Jo data pehle train ho chuka woh wapas nahi hoga, aur choti labs is rule ko ignore bhi kar sakti hain. Publishers ke liye jeet hai, lekin poori jeet abhi door hai.

https://dealroom.co/news/167596-anthropi.what: Anthropic Nasdaq par 'ANT' ticker se list hone ja raha hai — $1.5-2 trillion valuation, $100B+ raise ka target, history ka sab se bara IPO.
https://dealroom.co/news/167596-anthropi.why: Revenue 14x barh kar $16.3B ho gaya, lekin $807B ke 10-saal ke compute contracts bhi lock hain. Ye IPO ek company ki listing nahi, AI economy ka stress test hai.
https://dealroom.co/news/167596-anthropi.next: Roadshow November mein, listing 16 Nov wale hafte mein mutawaqqa — market ke mood par sab kuch depend karega.
https://dealroom.co/news/167596-anthropi.take: Meri take: $2 trillion? Itni bari valuation ke liye growth ko aasmaan tak jaana hoga. Numbers impressive hain, lekin $807B ki commitments dekh kar lagta hai ye bet hai, guarantee nahi. Investor banne se pehle S-1 parhna, headline nahi.

https://tribune.com.pk/story/2637632/doo.what: DoorDash ne Instacart ko $17B mein khareed liya — $65 per share, 26% premium. Restaurant delivery se grocery tak ka safar.
https://tribune.com.pk/story/2637632/doo.why: Restaurant delivery mature ho rahi hai; growth ab weekly grocery shops mein hai. Instacart ki grocery tech + DoorDash ki delivery network = Walmart/Amazon se muqabla.
https://tribune.com.pk/story/2637632/doo.next: Close 2027 end/2028 start tak, antitrust review sab se bara risk — NYC ne pehle hi consolidation par tashweesh zahir kar di.
https://tribune.com.pk/story/2637632/doo.take: Meri take: Delivery apps ki duniya mein ab sirf giants bachenge. Chote players ke liye ye warning hai: scale lo ya bik jao. Aur gig workers? Un ka zikr deal mein kahin nahi — hamesha ki tarah.

https://medium.com/@shaaravraghu/todays-.what: Mistral ne 1-trillion-parameter 'Le Chonk' ke open weights release kar diye — koi bhi ise apne hardware par chala sakta hai.
https://medium.com/@shaaravraghu/todays-.why: Closed models ke zamane mein open weights bari baat hai: Europe keh raha hai ke AI sirf 2-3 American companies ki jaagir nahi.
https://medium.com/@shaaravraghu/todays-.next: Dekhna ye hai ke developers ise asal products mein use karte hain ya ye sirf ek PR headline ban kar reh jata hai.
https://medium.com/@shaaravraghu/todays-.take: Meri take: Naam funny hai, move serious hai. Open weights ka matlab hai choti companies aur researchers bhi frontier-level AI chala sakenge — yehi asli democratization hai, keynote slides wali nahi.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2041105/army-t.what: Angoor Adda mein Afghan firing ke jawab mein Pak Army ne Taliban posts tabah kar di — ek local shaheed, paanch zakhmi hue the.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041105/army-t.why: Border par ye silsila rukne ka naam nahi le raha. Har dafa jawab to diya jata hai, lekin asal masla — Afghan soil se attacks — waheen ka waheen hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041105/army-t.next: Dekhna hai ke ye ek waqea rehta hai ya border tensions phir barhti hain; diplomatic channel par bhi nazar rakhni hogi.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041105/army-t.take: Meri take: Jawabi karwai zaroori hai, lekin sirf jawab kaafi nahi. Jab tak Afghan side se attacks ka source band nahi hota, border ke gaon wale hi qeemat chukate rahenge. Un ki hifazat pehli priority honi chahiye.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2041095.what: Senate mein garm behas: 48% regional poor Pakistan mein, detained PTI khawateen ke ilaaj ka mutalba, aur extrajudicial killings par tashweesh.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041095.why: Ye teenon masle ek hi baat ki taraf ishara karte hain — aam aadmi ki zindagi mushkil, aur siyasat mein insani lehja kam hota ja raha hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041095.next: Noreen Niazi ke ilaaj aur family access par hukoomat ki assurance par amal hoga ya nahi, ye agle dinon mein saaf hoga.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041095.take: Meri take: 70 saal ki beemar khatoon ki detention par behas honi hi nahi chahiye thi. Siyasat apni jagah, lekin buzurg aur beemar logon ke saath insani salook par koi compromise nahi hona chahiye — yehi hamari pehchan hai.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2041111.what: PPP doosre din bhi opposition ko electoral reforms committee mein lane ki koshish mein — opposition ne mashawarat ke liye waqt manga.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041111.why: Har election ke baad dhandli ka shor, phir committee, phir wahi kahani. Is dafa farq ye hai ke PPP khud opposition ko table par la raha hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041111.next: Opposition ka jawab aayega to pata chalega ke ye asal reform hai ya ek aur photo-op.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041111.take: Meri take: Ali Zafar ne sahi kaha — masla qanoon ki kami nahi, amal ka hai. Naye qanoon banane se pehle purane qanoon par amal kar ke dikhao, warna ye committee bhi fileon mein dafan ho jayegi.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2041093.what: LPG cylinder market mein Rs6,000-7,200, Ogra price Rs3,296 — farq dogna se zyada. PM ne 8-member committee bana di, ek mahine mein report degi.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041093.why: Iran border band, sea imports kam — supply ka masla hai, lekin price-setting Ogra se SOEs ko dene ki tajweez par stakeholders ko aitbar nahi.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041093.next: Committee ki report batayegi ke price neeche aayega ya naya system purane se mehenga sabit hoga.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041093.take: Meri take: Sardiyan aa rahi hain aur cylinder ki qeemat dogni — ye ghareeb gharano ke liye seedha bojh hai. Committee achi hai, lekin logon ko fori relief chahiye, report ka ek mahina lamba lagta hai.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2041022/pm-ord.what: PM ne GB ke 100MW solar project ki jald takmeel ka hukm diya, aur 1 Nov ko GB visit bhi mutawaqqa hai — liberation day ke mauqe par.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041022/pm-ord.why: GB mein bijli ka masla purana hai; solar project agar waqt par mukammal ho to sardiyon mein farq par sakta hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041022/pm-ord.next: PM ki visit par elanat honge; asal test ye hai ke project ground par kab chalta hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2041022/pm-ord.take: Meri take: GB ke logon ko bijli chahiye, taqreerein nahi. Solar project acha qadam hai — bas 'jald takmeel' ka wada is dafa waqei jald ho, kyun ke GB mein har saal yehi sunne ko milta hai.

https://www.nation.com.pk/31-Oct-2026/pa.what: Aaj Gaddafi Stadium mein final — Pakistan vs Sri Lanka, pehli home tri-series title ki talaash (aakhri 2008 mein).
https://www.nation.com.pk/31-Oct-2026/pa.why: Pakistan ne teen matches jeete, phir 110 par out ho gaya. Top order (Fakhar 31, Babar 118 runs in 4 matches) hi sab se bari fikar hai; bowling strong hai.
https://www.nation.com.pk/31-Oct-2026/pa.next: Final aaj hai — jo team pressure sambhalegi, trophy us ki. Babar ke liye bari innings ka mauqa hai.
https://www.nation.com.pk/31-Oct-2026/pa.take: Meri take: Ghar mein final, crowd ke saamne — is se behtar mauqa nahi. Bas top order ko 110 wali kahani dobara nahi dohrani. Babar, aaj bari innings ka din hai, warna Sri Lanka phir party kharab kar dega.

mood: 💥 $6.3B hack, tech stocks ka crash aur Lahore mein final — aaj ki hawa tez aur dilchasp hai.
